notes.title: Major updates & 4 new Winter Holiday levels!
notes.content:
New updates on RoboHeist (December 2018)!

- 4 brand new WINTER HOLIDAY SPECIAL levels! Eat all the Ginger bread cookies before the robots find and kill you!

- Lots of lighting improvements on levels! We have added more lights and adjusted brightness etc. on all the levels.

- Updates on graphics and other improvements!

- Fixed bugs on Leaderboards!
